entries.title: Leviticus 12:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: 1 The purification of a woman after childbirth. 6 Her offerings for her purifying.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a lamb. 1:10-13; 5:6-10; 14:22; 15:14,29; Nu 6:10; Lu 2:22; Joh 1:29 2Co 5:21; Heb 7:26; 1Pe 1:18,19 of the first year. Heb. a son of his year.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: she be not able to bring a lamb. Heb. her hand find notsufficiency of a lamb. 1:14; 5:7; 14:22; 15:14,29; Lu 2:22,24; 2Co 8:9 make an atonement. 4:26 When burnt offerings and sin offerings were brought together, the sin offerings were first offered.
